classification: SUBSTANTIVE_REVIEW_VERIFIED for source behavior; conditional payroll-policy question and runtime boundary behavior remain unverified; no new confirmed finding

independent_validation.method: Coordinator independently read the callable, NormalHourlyRate, biometric checkout caller, correction request/route/handler, settings writer/defaults, payroll ledger consumer, and cited test-source ranges; compared them to the specialist handoff and original receipt. No tests were executed.

verified_behavior: NormalHourlyRate returns zero for nonpositive workday hours; otherwise integer-divides daily-wage piastres, truncating any remainder.

For overtimeHours <= 0 the result has the calculated rate and zero amount. For positive hours, amount is Math.Round(rate.Piastres * overtimeHours * overtimeMultiplier), default midpoint-to-even, then converted to Money piastres.
The pure helper does not validate a negative/non-finite multiplier or bound positive hours. Runtime conversion/overflow behavior was not tested.
Biometric check-out floors overtime hours to zero and only writes a positive amount as a deterministic employee/date ledger credit; its negative calculated amount would be suppressed.

Attendance correction is manager-authorized and transaction-scoped; it computes new minus old overtime amount and applies a signed ledger adjustment. If an authorized setting were negative, the sign can reverse conditionally. No evidence found that such a setting exists in deployed data.
Payroll later consumes employee ledger entries; the payroll creation handler does not call this helper directly.

test_source_review.domain: PayrollRulesTests.cs:47-62 covers zero and conventional 20,000/10*2*1.5 = 6,000 piastres only.
test_source_review.attendance: AttendanceVerticalSliceTests.cs:100-109 checks a zero-overtime check-out; inspected correction cases do not assert malformed multiplier or precise signed overtime deltas.
test_source_review.payroll: PayrollVerticalSliceTests.cs:93-109 confirms an already-posted 6,000-piastre overtime credit is consumed into the payroll line.

counters_and_limits: Default settings inspected are positive (10-hour day, multiplier 1.5).
No policy/documentation evidence establishes permitted multiplier, workday, rate, or overtime-hour bounds.
No incident, database record, deployed configuration, SQL Server behavior, overflow/non-finite behavior, or live API request was inspected.

disposition.reason: No actual invalid configuration or governing policy was established; concern remains conditional. Do not duplicate an existing finding based only on a theoretical input boundary.
disposition.owner_question: Define allowed finite/nonnegative range for overtime multiplier, valid workday-hours range and correction overtime-hours bounds.
disposition.if_policy_requires_bounds: Validate settings writes and attendance-correction inputs consistently, then test zero/negative/non-finite/extreme inputs, rate truncation and midpoint rounding, and signed old/new adjustment direction if policy requires.

remaining_action: No further review of this callable body is required unless new contradictory evidence appears. Keep policy and runtime boundaries in the financial completion limitations; continue the next unverified material payroll callable.
